tools.Name: CLI-Anything
tools.Description: A framework that transforms any software with a codebase into an agent-native tool by automatically generating a structured CLI interface.
tools.Use_Case: Enabling AI agents to control professional software (e.g., GIMP, Blender, LibreOffice) via standard terminal commands instead of fragile GUI automation.

tools.Name: CloakBrowser
tools.Description: A stealth Chromium binary that passes complex bot detection tests by applying patches at the C++ source level rather than using simple JavaScript injection.
tools.Use_Case: Bypassing sophisticated anti-bot systems like Cloudflare Turnstile or DataDome for web scraping and AI agent browsing tasks.

tools.Name: Shadowbroker
tools.Description: A decentralized geospatial intelligence platform that aggregates 60+ real-time telemetry feeds (flights, maritime, satellite, conflict, etc.) into a unified map.
tools.Use_Case: Real-time global monitoring and threat intelligence, with support for connecting AI agents to analyze data patterns and coordinate complex intelligence tasks.
